smell_validity.evidence: Three distinct shapes of one ownership fault, the rightful owners still at work in each: the Data Matrix ECC pass re-derives the profile's block budgets, special case included, beside accessors still serving the layout pass; a stateless planner re-implements two live version-record queries; a helper owns the digit records' variant rule through copied parity. Divergence silently mis-lays codewords.

maintenance_impact.evidence: The injection leaves one rule in two places: block budgeting lives in the Data Matrix profile and inline in its heaviest consumer, so table changes must keep both copies in agreement, and divergence yields identical totals but wrong codeword layout — invisible. QR geometry and EAN variant choice get parallel split ownership, obscuring what belongs together and eroding confidence in changes.

development_plausibility.evidence: Excellent in-repo fit: the ECC change carries a genuine micro-optimization rationale in its comment, helper extraction plausibly names the EAN loop's rule, and terminology and placement match the symbology tables. Yet the planner retypes the live accessor formulas within the same file, and both consumers discard complementary tuple halves — constructed-looking rather than fully ordinary evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt turns a vague wish into a contract: it defines the pattern — symbol facts recomputed from raw record fields — bounds work to three encoding families, demands finding every site, orders removal of leftover pass-through scaffolding, and fixes bit-identical output, unmodified tests and no new exports. Its uneven-block caution pre-empts the most tempting silent repair: averaging the block budget.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Three encoding purposes, each needing a different code-supported decision: restore a block-indexed, in-loop consult of the profile preserving the uneven split; settle QR frame metrics across two asymmetric consumers and dissolve the stateless planner; author an owner-side digit rule that never existed, threading lead-digit parity and removing the per-code helper.

localization_burden.evidence: Only the three families are named; each site must be classified by combining a consumer's raw-field arithmetic with its holder's existing interface — Data Matrix budgeting against the profile's accessors, the planner against the record's live queries (it even sits in the version-table file). Legitimate field reads in sibling passes and EAN-8 must be excluded; no aliasing or configuration selection exists.

repair_coordination.evidence: Within clusters, locations must preserve shared rules: both QR consumers plus the type's deletion must settle on the record as sole authority, and any EAN owner-side method must agree with the loop's content-position semantics (parity indexing, guard placement) or bar patterns silently shift. Across clusters, though, the three packages repair independently; interacting rules are not demonstrated.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One rule — consult the owner's existing query methods instead of re-deriving from raw fields — genuinely repairs two of the three problem locations: restoring the profile accessors in the Data Matrix pass, and restoring the version record's metrics at both QR consumers, forcing the planner's deletion. That is about two-thirds coverage; the EAN site needs purpose-specific authoring, not substitution.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Identified edit and trigger: averaging the block budget works for every profile except the single 144x144 size, so ordinary encodes and unchanged codeword totals mask the wrong error-correction layout — a silent special-state failure, and the maintainer's own warning shows ordinary review would miss it. No crash path is evidenced; a second unchecked hidden path is not established.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
